content.short: Hopr Network is a blockchain data protection and enhanced privacy tool.
content.description: Hopr Network is a blockchain data protection and privacy tool that focuses on safeguarding wallet metadata. It obscures middlemen and bots from accessing details tied to your wallets when you perform transactions on a blockchain. By connecting Hopr Network to your crypto wallets, you gain an additional layer of protection during activities like buying NFTs, exchanging fiat on exchanges, or spending tokens in Dapps. Developers can run Hopr nodes to support and maintain the network.
